beats.headline: Baseball-sized, by the hundred
beats.text: The close fighting on the trains has given the xistera little use this floor. On the platform, with babababoons crawling all over the Nightmare, Carl calls one of his new Banger Spheres into the scoop and spins. It hits a babababoon in the neck with an audible splack, and the mob falls; he had been aiming between the eyes. They are nothing but spheres of dwarven robot scrap. He made a few hundred at his engineering table after trying several sizes, and the system only gave the name to the baseball-sized ones. He has ideas for others, spiked balls among them. He throws two more, and the two mobs across the platform die.

beats.headline: Bass heavy, for distraction
beats.text: Carl made five of these at his sapper's table, each labelled for a purpose, and because he made them at the table he could pick the songs. This one is a hollow banger sphere with an impact-detonated alarm trap inside, labelled Bass heavy. For distraction. Katia lobs it down the stairs at the ooze, and the announcement comes: Jump Around. Sealed in the metal ball, the music is quieter than usual and still shakes the walls. The ball protects the trap and bounces up and down with the beat, and every time the ooze grabs for it, it slips away. Donut objects to the song in capital letters.

beats.headline: Spiked, into a wing
beats.text: Turkeys are piling over one another to reach them, Donut is standing on the passed-out Mongo, and Carl cannot even cast Protective Shell. He pulls a banger sphere, one of his spiked ones, and launches it at the boss turkey up in the rafters. Tom squawks and tries to dodge. The ball smacks into a wing and breaks it with an audible crack. Carl pulls another, but Tom drops from the high rafter and disappears into the mass of turkeys surging toward them.

beats.headline: Through their own windshield
beats.text: The plan worked out with Chiyome and the bugbears needs the truck's windshield gone the moment the race starts, so Carl holds a special banger sphere, built to destroy the whole windshield in one hit rather than poke a hole in it. The hail starts light and grows. Hailstones shake the ground, and ice and water cover the glass until he cannot see the lights. Green light. He hurls the sphere through the windshield, which shatters, and the sphere keeps going. Suddenly they can more or less see. In the distance a hailstone the size of a two-story house smashes into the ground.

beats.headline: The ball in slot ten
beats.text: An effect from Eris has swapped every nearby crawler's inventory with the crawler closest to them, and Donut is holding Carl's. With ten seconds to Scolopendra's next attack he shouts for her to combine the ball in slot ten of his hotlist with the biscuit in slot twelve. There is no twelve, she shrieks; search and combine, he tells her, and she finds it and drops the ball into his xistera. He puts the motorcycle down, launching them into the air, and throws. The banger sphere with the Nothing Special enriched pet biscuit goes straight into the boss's mouth, and Scolopendra splatters into a quivering puddle the size of a small elephant.
